name: 错版印刷所 / Misaki Print Lab

pageSections.content: M1saK1 作者身份 + 最新文章
作者技术、审美与兴趣色版

contentRule: 不创建没有真实数据的作品空区块；未来作品沿用文章印张结构接入。

hero.composition: Full-bleed real article cover. Oversized M1saK1 is the first focal point and semantic h1; duplicated aria-hidden blue/orange/yellow layers create registration. Latest article title becomes h2 in a stable lower caption area.
hero.viewport: Height is capped below the viewport so the archive edge remains visible on desktop and mobile.
hero.subjectTreatment: The author name remains readable at every registration offset. DESIGN / CODE / PLAY identifies the three plates without turning into explanatory copy.
hero.registration: Pointer or touch position sets x/y CSS variables clamped to +/-8px; pointer leave/release settles to zero. Initial load moves from preset misregistration to aligned state.
hero.feed: From hero top to exit, a requestAnimationFrame-throttled scroll progress variable moves the cover/copy no more than 48px and closes the crop no more than 6%; links remain clickable.
hero.easterEgg: Three activations of the author mark within 900ms reveal LOT 14987 / ZERO SUGAR as a decorative batch stamp for 1400ms, without layout shift.

layoutRules.desktop: Keep sticky left rail. Hero and every section remain a full content band, not floating cards. Archive uses 3 columns only where each item stays at least 220px wide.
layoutRules.tablet: Keep composition but use 2-column archive and reduce registration layers to +/-6px.
layoutRules.mobile: Use existing mobile header, single-column archive, hero at least 540px and no taller than viewport minus 108px. Touch movement can register plates without preventing vertical scrolling; release aligns them. Keep the next section edge visible.
layoutRules.article: No pointer tracking, parallax, registration, sticky transform, or continuous text motion in article content. Existing reading progress, focus, TOC, code and heading controls remain stable.

actions.registration: Color layers move into alignment to reveal author facets.
actions.feed: Hero and archive items travel vertically as paper entering the press.
actions.cut: A hard horizontal ink bar crosses a section once as it enters view.
actions.flip: Hover/focus lifts only a small item corner and exposes its process color.

rules: At most one dominant motion at a time.
No generic ambient float or endless loop.
All section reveals run once and settle completely.
Interactive motion must have an equivalent focus state.

interactionStates.default: All content readable and links operable before JS.
interactionStates.hover: Registration or paper-corner feedback only; no neighbor movement.
interactionStates.focusVisible: 2px black outline with 4px offset plus the same paper-corner state.
interactionStates.loading: No full-screen loader; hero is immediately readable.
interactionStates.noJs: Final aligned layout with no hidden content.

reducedMotion: Force registration offsets and feed progress to zero.
Disable section cut/reveal transforms and smooth scrolling.
Keep hover/focus color and outline feedback.
Batch stamp appears and disappears without animated transform.
acceptanceChecks: M1saK1 is the first-screen h1 and dominant focal point.
Latest article title, description and link remain visible and clickable.
Registration offset never exceeds 8px and returns to alignment.
Archive, about, subjects and friends reveal through print actions rather than generic fades.
Triple activation reveals one non-blocking batch stamp with no layout shift.
No continuous motion exists inside article reading content.
Desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 have no overflow or incoherent overlap.
Mobile preserves registration through touch/scroll and shows a hint of the next section.
prefers-reduced-motion keeps every control and all content usable.
Astro production build passes and no new dependency is added.
forbiddenDeviations: No hacker, terminal, scanline or glitch language.
No WebGL or animation dependency for this direction.
No redesign of article typography or user-modified markdown font.
